div.head: II As 1.4
div.ab: And gyf he ofer þæt stalie, ðonne forgyldan hi hine be his were oððe hine eft ingebringan.
⁊ gif he ofer ðæt stalige, forgildon hy hine be his were oþþe hine eft ðær inne gebringan.
⁊ gif he ofer þæt stalie, þonne forgylden hie hine be his were oððe hine eft þær inne gebringen.
Et si iterum furetur (postmodum), wera sua gildet eum, uel reddat similiter incarceratum.
⁊ gif he ofer ðæt stalige, forgildon hy hine be his were oþþe hine eft ðær inne gebringan.
If he steals after that, they [his kinsmen] shall pay for him to the amount of his wergeld or put him back there.
Und wenn er fernerhin stiehlt, (dann B So) sollen sie [die Verwandten] ihn durch sein Wergeld bezahlen oder ihn wieder dort [ins Gefängniss] hinein bringen.
And if he steals after that, (then, B So) they [the kinsmen] are to pay for him with his wergild or bring him back in there [into prison].
